rationale: v1.80.1 already builds the device-dialog preview from the marker draft and computes entity-marker icons through icon rules, so an auto-placed light group shows mdi:chip in the preview and after Save while the plan shows mdi:lightbulb-group. Fixes that existing behaviour without a config migration or a new feature.

summary.ru: Группа света без ручной иконки показывает иконку группы в предпросмотре, в поле «Auto» и на плане после сохранения.
summary.en: A light group without a manual icon keeps the group icon in the preview, the “Auto” field and on the plan after saving.
